reading: The judges love Sill Line, Squared for being "the most complete system" (style 8, skeptic: "the best Home and Status in the heat"). They credit the reading order (question, box, steel branch of starters, then the week standing on one rail lit only from now to stop one), the square tick on To do's rail, the rule heads, one type scale, the T buffer and 'All plans', the Chat track ending at 'your turn', and Status as one graphite faceplate (lamp board plus a square-root needle meter with a ghost needle). It came 7.87, level with Trued, Desk and Waypoint, so a tie, not a lead. Every lens named the same faults, and they are what would make it win. (1) Below the sill the page goes plain: To do and Lately added are boxed slate panels again (feedback, style, system, skeptic, soul's "one lamp per section"). (2) The foot is a long empty legend rail on every page, about 80px of dead ground (system, style, skeptic). (3) Coming up draws one list twice, a green tube and three slate plates (interaction), and the plates float above the rail with their numerals below it, so plate and stop read as two things (feedback). The plate caps lean navy (#86a9cc, skeptic), the plates repeat the kind in tracked caps and put the time in boxed chips (usability), and the tube sits above the rail instead of dropping a lit wire onto it as Ticked's did (feedback, soul). (4) The greeting box went matte, so the question is no longer read on the tube (soul). (5) On the phone the week is below the fold (system, interaction, usability, style). (6) Small things: 'Day' is missing on the To do page, the tracked-caps column heads, VT323 row names at 10px on Status, the 'avg' label colliding with the needle, loose tallies, and 'Mount St. / Helens' wrapping. The cross lessons add three: green is about 65% on Home (the target is 60% or less, and any hue removed must be replaced), the field is converging (keep the signature device, here the sill and its lit wire), and the owner wants the original tube light back where the phosphor is. What wins: keep the board standing on its sill as the one drawn object, draw the whole week in one plate grammar with the tube as the lit plate wired to stop one, hang everything below the sill unboxed from short tracks, swap the empty legend rail for a working machine foot, and give the greeting's glass its light back without adding glare.

briefs.name: Sill Line, Wired
briefs.hypothesis: Squared tied for first on its system and lost points only on what lies under and around the sill: boxed lower panels, an empty foot rail, a list drawn twice, a matte box and a week below the phone's fold. Every one of those is a named, repeated fix. Closing all of them, while giving back the original tube light only on the lit path (glass, the 'plan' halo, the now lamp, the wire to stop one), keeps the line's signature (the board standing on a sill lit only from now to stop one) and removes every reason a lens gave for ranking it below Trued or Desk. The three grafts each tie this line's own lit object to its own list, which is the pattern of the grafts that took in 14a. None is a pasted strip.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-sill-cross (copy palettes/x14a-sill-cross.json and variants/x14a-sill-cross/, build through src/build.py; put the new rules in a new src/wired.css appended last, and delete superseded rules from cross.css rather than override them, keeping the sheet under 200 KB).

HOME, THE BOARD (greeting):
- Eyebrow unchanged: her screen at 2rem, 'Vera', the date in DM Mono.
- The title (see the title field) is set as two pieces. 'What needs a plan?' is the display line at 3rem, Archivo 75% width 650 in --heading, with 'plan' lit: the kit's two-layer halo (6px at 55%, 22px at 22%) plus a 1px white-hot core (text-shadow 0 0 1px #eafff1). The '?' stays ink. 'Tell Vera.' sits on the same baseline after it at 1.5rem, Archivo 600 in --ink-2, as the box's spoken label. On the phone it drops under the line, left-aligned. Give the display line text-wrap: balance.
- The ask box gets its light back as glass, not a halo (soul's fix; ledger L092 light from below). The field keeps --field, plus an inset bottom-weighted glow: box-shadow inset 0 -18px 28px -18px rgb(109 255 156 / .16), with a 1px phosphor top highlight at 35% faded at both ends. Its resting outer halo stays at the cut 40%. A lit mono '›' prompt in #6dff9c with an 8px bloom leads the placeholder (L095). Inside the box's foot, above From / Send, add Folio's glass status line rebuilt in Sill's terms: '4 plans · 3 late · Vera is listening▊', in DM Mono .8125rem, --phosphor-dim with a 6px halo, the two figures bright, and the block cursor blinking at 1.06s (reduced motion: steady). It reads 'Vera is answering' while a turn runs. It is aria-hidden: the same facts are said elsewhere.
- Placeholder on one line: 'Plans, an idea, a reminder, the calendar…'. Textarea rows=2 on desktop, rows=1 that grows on the phone.
- The steel branch of starters stays as it is on desktop: the junction ring, 44px slate keys with arrows, the T buffer.

HOME, THE SILL (Coming up in one grammar; interaction's and feedback's fix):
- Every plan is a PLATE standing on the rail. The Next up tube is plate one, the lit plate: the same structure as the ink plates, glass where they are ink. The order in every plate is the kind ring (14px, its kind's colour), the name (Archivo 75% 600, 1.125rem, balanced, with 'Mount St. Helens' non-breaking), 'for Maya' in --dim, then one line with the time in DM Mono at body size (no sunk chip) and 'in 7 days' in sans --dim. The tracked-caps kind word is dropped: the ring carries the kind, and its title attribute names it. The whole plate is the link, with a 2px phosphor focus ring and hover lifting the plate to --surface-3. The tube keeps its VT323 'NEXT UP' tag, its scanlines and its bloom, and its radar shrinks to a 72px corner graticule (L094) so the tube can narrow to 22rem.
- Each plate stands on a 1px steel LEG down to its ring stop. The DAY NUMERAL moves ABOVE the rail at the plate's foot, between leg and plate edge: DM Mono 1.5rem figure, with month over weekday in .75rem in --label, set on the plate's bottom inner padding, so plate, leg, ring and date read as one stop (feedback). Nothing hangs under the rail except 'now' under the lamp and 'All plans' under the T buffer.
- The lit wire (Ticked's drop, restored; feedback, soul): from the tube's power lamp at its bottom-right, a 2px phosphor line drops straight onto stop one, ending in the lit ring. The run from the now lamp to stop one is the only lit run, with the kit's bloom (0 0 6px at 60%, 0 0 18px at 25%) and airglow masked to that run. The now lamp keeps its white-hot core and 2.4s breathing halo. Stop one onward is steel #56708c to the T buffer.
- Plate caps: replace #86a9cc with bone #cfc6b0 at 70% as a 2px top edge (skeptic), so no navy is left. Name it --plate-cap. The kind rings carry the companion hues (outing #b5c87d, shows #ff9fd0, plans #70dcf4, people #ffb850), at 1.5px ring weight, so colour stays and moves to the rings.
- The station head ('Coming up', '4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00' on its baseline, the Calendar note in small dim) sits as a rule head above the plates, not beside the tube.

HOME, BELOW THE SILL (unboxed; feedback, style, system, skeptic):
- Setup stays one strip, with its 3px amber left edge and 44px rings (ring 1 amber, 2 and 3 steel), and 'Next: choose your own password'. It is the only filled strip below the sill.
- To do and Lately added drop .panel's background, border and radius. Each is a rule head on the ground (condensed head, a 1px --line-2 rule, the count and links on the baseline at the right), and the list hangs from a SHORT TRACK: a 2px steel rail at the left that starts with a 6px ring at the rule head and ends in a T buffer under the last row. Each section gets one lamp (soul's rule). To do's lamp is the solid phosphor NOW line across its list, with 'now' in the margin. Lately added's lamp is its newest kind ring, which carries a 4px phosphor dot at its centre, breathing. Everything else is steel and ink.
- To do on Home and on /tasks uses the same heads, sentence case, 12px Archivo 600, --label, no tracking: 'Day', 'Done', 'Thing to do', 'Who', 'Due', and 'Edit' on the page only (type, usability, feedback, soul: 'Day' shown on both). The square tick keeps its 1.375rem box, 2px #56708c edge and 44px hit area. Hover and focus fill it --surface-3 with the check at 45%. Late is said in amber words only.
- The kids' wishes line hangs as the last stop of To do's track: a gift ring, then 'Maya 0 open · Theo 0 open · All'.

THE FOOT, EVERY PAGE (system, style, skeptic): delete the full-width legend rail. In its place is the machine's status foot, Plate's rebuilt on Sill's line. One 1px --line-2 rule, then a single line: a short 3rem steel rail from a lit 8px now lamp (the 'Ready' lamp, which breathes) to a small T, then 'Ready' in Archivo 600 ink, 'OpenAI gpt-6-luna' with the model in DM Mono, '$0.00 of $2.00 today' with DM Mono figures, and 'Status →' at the right. For an admin with trouble, the lamp and word take the status light's amber or red. Under it, on a second line in .75rem --dim, the lamp key appears only on pages that draw lamps (Status, To do, Plans): a lit dot for now, a steel ring for to come, a sage square for done, a half-amber dot for needs a look. Then the FamilyDB mark and the copyright line as today. The foot's height drops from about 150px to about 80px.

THE PHONE (system, interaction, usability, style): the order becomes the title, the box (one-line placeholder, the status line hidden under 24rem), then the starters folded into one horizontal scroll row of three 44px keys (with scroll-snap and a fade at the right edge, and no junction ring), then the sill. The rail turns down the left gutter from the now lamp, and stop one's plate (the tube) shows on the first 844px screen. The tube's wire drops left onto the gutter rail. The later plates are 44px rows on the same rail, in the same order (ring, name, time, relative), with the day numeral at the row's left.

STATUS: lamp-board row names move from VT323 to DM Mono at .8125rem, and lamp names to 12px minimum (type, system). The 'avg $0.04' label moves to the outer side of the ghost needle, outside the arc at its tip, and never inside the hot needle's sweep when both are under 10% (interaction, usability). The tallies sit under a 1px --line-2 rule with the label 'Today' in 12px label ink (skeptic). The faceplate's glass keeps the kit's scanlines and bloom: this is where the light belongs.

PLANS: the month's NOW run continues to the next plan's cell, through week breaks, ending in that day's lit ring (style). The plans list uses the same plate row grammar as Home's phone rows.

IDEAS, CHAT, SETTINGS, FORM: unchanged apart from the shared rule heads, the foot, and dropping the bone cap's former blue on Chat's family plates (now --plate-cap bone).

COLOUR BUDGET: aim for Home at 60% green or less by coloured pixels. Shrink the tube by 4rem, drop the board's own top glow to .35 (topGlow 0.35), and keep the glass status line dim. The bone cap and the coloured kind rings replace the navy, so no hue is removed without a replacement.
briefs.borrows:
Its own judges' fixes, by lens. (1) Unbox To do and Lately added into rule-headed lists hung from short tracks: feedback, style, system, skeptic, and soul's 'one lamp per section' from the cross lessons. (2) Replace the long empty legend rail at the foot: system (about 80px of dead ground), style (give it a lit NOW), skeptic (a short key, or only on pages with lamps). (3) One grammar for Next up and the later plates: interaction. Plates, legs, rings and date read as one stop with numerals above the rail: feedback. The tube touching the rail with a lit drop: feedback, soul. (4) Light back on the greeting box: soul. (5) Week above the phone's fold with a one-line placeholder and the starters as a row of keys: system, interaction, usability, style. (6) Plate caps from navy to bone or steel, the kind in the ring only: skeptic. No tracked-caps kind line, the time at body size not in a chip, the whole plate a link: usability. 'Day' on both To do views: feedback, soul, interaction, type, usability, skeptic. Sentence-case 12px heads, DM Mono instead of VT323 on Status, text-wrap: balance on plate titles: type. Lamp text at a 12px floor: system. The 'avg' label clear of the needle: interaction, usability. A rule above the tallies: skeptic. The month's NOW run carried to the next plan: style.

The other camp's features, rebuilt in Sill's colours, type and line:
(a) Folio, Railed Contents (x14a-folio-cross): the glass status line under the title, '4 plans · 3 late · Vera is listening▊'. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-folio-cross/templates/home.html line 60 (p.tube-status) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-folio-cross/sheet.css lines 3195-3197. Soul and style called it the most CRT-souled greeting in heat b. Here it goes in DM Mono inside the box's foot, so the box itself becomes lit glass again, which answers soul's fix and the owner's ask for the original light, and its words are status, not the label (the lesson of Folio's failed reach).
(b) Plate, Engraved (x14a-plate-cross): the machine's status foot on every page, 'Ready · OpenAI gpt-6-luna · $0.00 of $2.00 today · Status →'. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-plate-cross/templates/_ui.html (macro ready, lines 73-80, and the foot macro around lines 110-135) and its styles in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-plate-cross/cross.css (.ready, .pf-*). Here it is set on a 3rem stub of Sill's rail from a breathing now lamp to a T, so the foot keeps the line's grammar in a useful line instead of an empty legend strip.
(c) Desk Terminal, Patched (x14a-desk-cross): one row grammar for every plan (day numeral, name, then time and relative at body size, with no chip and no kind caps), with the Next item lit inside the same list rather than drawn as a separate object. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-desk-cross/templates/home.html (Coming up list) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-desk-cross/sheet.css. Here that grammar is used inside Sill's plates, which stay standing on the rail, and the tube becomes the lit plate of the same grammar. On the phone the plates become exactly Desk's rows on the gutter rail.
From the ledger, one more: L092 'Light from below: a bottom-weighted inset glow' (r3-rand-3 Rose Embers; full entry in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/ledger-for-sill.md), applied to the ask box alone as glass lit from beneath. It is paired with L095, the lit '›' prompt glyph, and L094, a small graticule in place of the tube's large radar.

KEEPS: the question first, the box, the steel branch with its junction ring, the board standing on its sill with the rail past both sides, the lit run only from now to stop one, the T buffer and 'All plans', the square tick, rule heads, one type system, Status's faceplate, Ideas' line from home, and Chat's track to 'your turn'. GIVES UP: the foot's full-width legend rail, the slate panels below the sill, the plates' kind caps and time chips, the navy plate cap, the tube's large radar, and VT323 on Status's row names.
briefs.avoids: Boxed lower half: To do and Lately added are now unboxed on short tracks, each with one lamp (feedback, style, system, skeptic, soul). Empty legend rail: replaced by an 80px working status foot, with the key only where lamps are drawn (system, style, skeptic). One list drawn twice, plates floating above stops: one plate grammar, with the tube as the lit plate, legs to rings and numerals above the rail (interaction, feedback). The tube resting above the rail: the lit wire drops onto stop one (feedback, soul). The matte greeting box: glass lit from below, plus the glass status line (soul). Week below the phone's fold: one-line box and a scroll row of starters, so the tube shows on the first screen (system, interaction, usability, style). Navy caps: bone, with colour moved to the kind rings, so no hue is lost (skeptic, the colour-drain lesson). Tracked caps and chips: removed (usability, type). 'Day' inconsistency, VT323 legibility, the 'avg' collision, loose tallies, and the 'St. / Helens' break: all fixed. Green share: the smaller tube, a lower topGlow and a dim status line aim for 60% or less on Home. The cross lessons' warnings: no ring-as-tick (the square tick stays), no household strip copied from Quote or Settled, no pasted cords, and the line keeps its signature device (the sill and its wire) so it does not converge with the field.
briefs.title: "What needs a *plan*? Tell Vera." with 'plan' lit (two layers plus a white-hot core) and the '?' in ink. It has not been tried. It keeps the line's best title, 'What needs a plan?' (the skeptic's first in heat b, and joint first for soul, interaction, type and usability), whose short lit word sits over the lit run of plans that answers it and cannot be answered 'no'. It adds the one thing every lens credited in 'Give Vera something to plan.': it names who hears you. 'Tell Vera.' is set smaller in --ink-2 on the same baseline, as the box's spoken label, so a newcomer knows the box sends to Vera, and the title does not join the seven lines that converged on 'Give Vera…'. It says FamilyDB's job: whatever needs a plan (a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish), you hand it to Vera here.
